Lina Ortiz: Heads-up: SparkPilot accepted our pilot invite but procurement asked for a one-pager on data handling and an onboarding calendar. Also asked if we can tailor training to product search use cases.
Marcus Lee: I'll draft the one-pager today. Will include retention, export, and redaction sections. ETA 4pm PST.
Priya Desai: For onboarding, SparkPilot prefers mornings. I can offer Tue/Wed 9am PT slots next week. Do we want a 60m session with hands-on prompts?
Omar Ruiz: Recommend 60m: 20m intro + 25m guided promptworkshop + 15m Q&A. We'll include sample prompt pack focused on search relevance and rerank.
Lina Ortiz: Sounds good. Also, procurement wants a sample telemetry export showing masked identifiers. Marcus can you add an example payload?
Marcus Lee: Example sanitized export below:
```
{"event":"query","user_id":"[MASKED]","query_text":"[REDACTED]","ranked_results":5,"latency_ms":48,"ts":"2025-09-10T14:22:10Z"}
```
Priya Desai: I'll send the calendar options and include a short pre-read: quick-start + 3 suggested search prompts. Link to pre-read: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/sparkpilot/pre-read
pilot-sync-bot: Reminder: Attach post-session micro-survey using /pilot-survey to capture blockers.
Omar Ruiz: For feedback capture, propose a 4-question micro-survey: usefulness, integration blockers, SSO/provisioning issues, follow-up request. If they select integration blocker, auto-create a ticket in CS queue.
Lina Ortiz: Good. Also flag for renewal-risk: if they answer "major integration blocker" or rate us <=2 on usefulness, tag on pilot board.
Marcus Lee: One-pager draft posted: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/sparkpilot/data-onepager v1. Will request legal review.
Priya Desai: Booked enablement: Wed 2025-09-17 09:00 PT (60m). Invite sent to SparkPilot admins.
Omar Ruiz: I'll prepare a 6-prompt exercise for search and a short benchmark script to show token costs and latency.
Lina Ortiz: Action items: Marcus finalize one-pager + sanitized payload, Priya send invites & pre-read, Omar build prompt exercise & benchmark, all monitor survey responses post-session. I'll compile notes and add any renewal risk flags.
pilot-sync-bot: Thread will auto-archive to pilot-coordination after 72h of inactivity.
